title: Cancellations and No-Shows — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
**Specimen Collection Appointments: cancellation and no-show rules.**

## Who cancels

The patient, or the provider office or care facility that booked the visit, may cancel a booked visit at any time before check-in; such a cancellation is recorded as initiated by the patient. The laboratory cancels for staffing, a closed site or a weather closure; such a cancellation is recorded as initiated by the laboratory.

## Fees on a cancellation

A patient cancellation recorded with less than the visit type's free-change notice (in hours) before the appointment start assesses the visit type's late-cancellation fee, when that fee is above 0.00. Notice is measured in elapsed hours from the moment the cancellation is recorded to the appointment date and time, and a cancellation at exactly the free-change notice counts as timely. A laboratory cancellation never assesses a fee.

## No-shows

A visit not checked in by the end of the visit type's arrival grace period after its start is recorded as a no-show. For a Patient Service Center appointment whose late-arrival term is "served as a walk-in", a late arrival is served as a walk-in and the appointment is not a no-show.

*Retired term — no longer in force:* the former term that a visit recorded as a no-show assesses the visit type's no-show fee when that fee is above 0.00. The no-show charge on a missed home visit now follows the current no-show charge basis.

## Recollection visits and the order

No fee of any kind is assessed on a recollection visit where the visit type waives collection-service fees on recollection visits. A cancellation or a no-show leaves the order untouched: the order still awaits its specimen and may be booked again.

## Decision table

| Event | Initiated by | Notice before start | Visit type's late-cancellation fee | Recollection visit with fees waived | Fee on the cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cancellation | Laboratory | Any | Any | Any | None |
| Cancellation | Patient, provider office or facility | At or beyond the free-change notice | Any | Any | None |
| Cancellation | Patient, provider office or facility | Less than the free-change notice | Above 0.00 | No | The late-cancellation fee |
| Cancellation | Patient, provider office or facility | Less than the free-change notice | 0.00 | — | None |
| Cancellation | Any | Any | Any | Yes | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical times)

- A Mobile In-Home Collection Visit (free-change notice 24 hours) due to start at 10:00 on day D: a patient cancellation recorded at 10:00 on day D minus 1 is exactly 24 hours ahead and is timely; one recorded at 10:01 on day D minus 1 is less than 24 hours ahead and assesses the late-cancellation fee.
- A Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment patient who arrives after the grace period is served as a walk-in and is not recorded as a no-show.
